teaching.title: Introductory Programming Teaching Assistant
bullets: Assisted introductory programming lab sessions and prepared worked examples on variables, conditionals, and loops for instructor review.
Answered student questions during office hours about introductory programming topics, including variables, conditionals, and loops.

teaching.title: Peer Programming Mentor
bullets: Explained worked examples involving functions, variables, and conditionals under a course instructor's supervision.
Supported beginner practice sessions focused on programming with functions, variables, and conditionals.

projects.title: Graph Property Checker
bullets: Translated discrete mathematical definitions into C++ program functions as a contribution to a team graph property checker project.
Tested the implementation against hand-worked cases and constructed examples and counterexamples for the represented rules.

projects.title: Contact Index
bullets: Implemented linked structures and traversal operations for an individual contact index project using C++ and Git.
Documented operation costs and boundary cases, and wrote tests for insertion, lookup, and deletion.
